description: The IDEMS International team maintains carbonr, an R package for calculating carbon-equivalent emissions with factors from the United Kingdom government's 2024 conversion-factor report. Its README links a JOSS paper and describes repeatable calculations across activities. Users supply activity quantities and select relevant factors; outputs are estimated CO2-equivalent totals with calculation context. Geographic applicability follows the factor source and activity assumptions. GitHub metadata states LGPL-3.0 licensing for the code. A limitation is that a national factor may not represent a specific supplier, electricity grid or future year; the factor version must be recorded. The package can calculate emissions for transport, building or energy-system scenarios. The related Brightway catalogue platform supports full life-cycle assessment, while carbonr applies listed conversion factors. No factor table or package was downloaded.
name: carbonr emissions-factor calculator
